SELECT 
  t1.RecordRegistry AS record_id, 
  t1.GdprComp AS gdpr_compliance_status, 
  t1.LocLawComp AS local_law_compliance_status, 
  CONCAT(t2.orignation, ' to ', t2.destnation) AS transfer_path 
FROM 
  Compliance AS t1 
  JOIN DataFlow AS t2 ON t1.RecordRegistry = t2.RecordRegistry 
WHERE 
  t1.GdprComp = 'Non-compliant' 
  OR t1.LocLawComp = 'Non-compliant' 
ORDER BY 
  record_id;

SELECT 
  t1.RecordRegistry AS record_id, 
  t1.GdprComp AS gdpr_compliance_status, 
  t1.LocLawComp AS local_law_compliance_status, 
  CONCAT(t2.orignation, ' to ', t2.destnation) AS transfer_path 
FROM 
  Compliance AS t1 
  JOIN DataFlow AS t2 ON t1.RecordRegistry = t2.RecordRegistry 
WHERE 
  t1.GdprComp = 'Non-compliant' 
  OR t1.LocLawComp = 'Non-compliant' 
ORDER BY 
  record_id;
